studio.title: Open 3D Viewer Studio
studio.desc: Explore your 3D models. Navigate, select elements, cut sections and measure directly in the viewport.
studio.meta: Open 3D Viewer Studio: desktop Revit and IFC, 3D navigation, properties, layers, section box, measurement, explode and IFC export. With a WebGPU web version.
studio.why: Open a model and explore its contents. Orbit your design, hide layers and select an element to inspect its available properties. Look inside with a section box or section plane; check distances, angles and areas with the measurement tools.
studio.preview: Images show a development build. Features and supported formats may differ from the web version or an earlier desktop download.
studio.shotHouse: Revit sample house in the desktop viewer, with layers and model information.
features: Orbit, pan and zoom. Switch between isometric, top, front and right views, perspective and orthographic projection.
Select an element and inspect the properties made available by its file reader.
Show or hide layers to focus on different parts of a model.
Switch between solid, wireframe and edges. Use the grid and view cube for orientation.
Cut through the model with a bounding box or plane, with filled cut surfaces.
Measure distances, angles, polygons and areas. Results appear in the 3D viewport.
Separate elements or storeys to explore the model structure.
Save an open model as IFC 4 with triangulated geometry and available element data. This is not a complete native roundtrip.
studio.formatsIntro: Revit and IFC import run in the desktop app. The web version uses WebGPU and supports fewer import formats. Files may not display completely or exactly as in their original application.
formats: Categories, levels, grids, rooms and saved views where available in the file.
Geometry, placements, units and openings; selectable elements with IFC type, GlobalId and available properties.
Partial reader for classic and 2021+ files. Some models fail; textures appear as colour tints.
Version dependent and incomplete. Profiles may be approximate boxes; cuts, offsets, rotations and chamfers are not fully applied.
In the browser: GLB or glTF with embedded buffers. Textures appear as average colour tints.
MTL colours on desktop; no full texture rendering.
ASCII and binary, with faces. Point clouds without faces are not supported.
studio.limits: STEP, DWG/DXF, FBX and point cloud formats such as E57 and LAS are not supported yet. Walk mode, multiple simultaneous models and full texture rendering are also unavailable.
studio.license: Built in Rust with iced and wgpu. The desktop app targets Windows, Linux and macOS; the web version requires a WebGPU browser. The viewer source is LGPL-3.0-or-later. The standard desktop build also includes a proprietary Revit reader, so the complete package is not wholly open source.
studio.video: A Revit sample house and a real Tekla model in the same viewer: orbit, select an element, inspect properties, use the section box and measure a distance. The video will follow once the new interface and Tekla demo model have been checked.
studio.end: Start in the browser with GLB, OBJ or STL. Use the desktop app for Revit and IFC.

studio.teklaDesc: Captured from the desktop viewer with a real .db1 model. Geometry is still incomplete: this image previews the reader and is not a complete verification of the Tekla source model.
